name: codex_doctor
description: Check the installed Codex CLI version, sign-in status and configuration. Run on demand to diagnose failures; it changes no configuration.

refresh.description: Re-probe the CLI instead of reusing the cached diagnosis.

working_dir.description: Absolute directory to run the check in. Codex loads the configuration of the directory it runs in, so pass the one a delegation would use. Defaults to this server's own.
